actions.label: Initial keyboard focus
actions.expected: Keyboard traversal begins from the application's actual initial active element.

actions.label: Reach the Library search
actions.expected: The target is reached from the actual current focus using keyboard traversal only.

actions.label: Select the Library query
actions.expected: The focused Library search owns the select-all shortcut, not the canvas graph.

actions.label: Filter Library for Prompt
actions.expected: The Library narrows using text typed through its keyboard-reached search field.
actions.actual: Typed 6 characters through the active keyboard target.

actions.label: Add Prompt from the Library
actions.expected: The target is reached from the actual current focus using keyboard traversal only.
actions.actual: Reached Add Prompt with 1 Tab key event.

actions.label: Add Prompt from the Library
actions.expected: Enter creates the canonical node through the ordinary Library command.

actions.label: Reach the authoring canvas
actions.expected: The target is reached from the actual current focus using keyboard traversal only.
actions.actual: Reached Authoring canvas with 19 Tab key events.

actions.label: Open canvas quick add
actions.expected: N opens the searchable node palette while the canvas owns focus.

actions.label: Filter quick add for Note
actions.expected: Quick add filters with text typed into its product-owned autofocus field.
actions.actual: Typed 4 characters through the active keyboard target.

actions.label: Insert Note from quick add
actions.expected: Enter inserts the active matching canonical node and returns focus to the canvas.

actions.label: Select Prompt from its focused title
actions.expected: The target is reached from the actual current focus using keyboard traversal only.
actions.actual: Reached Prompt 1 with 4 Tab key events.

actions.label: Select Prompt from its focused title
actions.expected: Space selects the keyboard-reached node without using a pointer.

actions.label: Open the focused Prompt title editor
actions.expected: F2 opens one bounded title editor for the selected Prompt.

actions.label: Select title editor text
actions.expected: The inline editor keeps Ctrl+A local instead of selecting graph nodes.

actions.label: Type the Prompt title
actions.expected: The bounded F2 editor receives typed text while graph selection remains unchanged.
actions.actual: Typed 14 characters through the active keyboard target.

actions.label: Commit the focused title editor
actions.expected: Enter commits the title edit and closes the inline editor.

actions.label: Return to the canvas after title editing
actions.expected: The target is reached from the actual current focus using keyboard traversal only.
actions.actual: Reached Authoring canvas with 0 Tab key events.

actions.label: Select both authored nodes
actions.expected: The canvas-owned command selects the two blank-authored nodes.

actions.label: Keyboard multi-selection
actions.expected: Ctrl+A is the documented keyboard route for selecting all authored canvas nodes.
actions.actual: The blank-authored Prompt and Note are selected together before duplicate, copy, paste, delete, undo, and redo.

actions.label: Duplicate the keyboard selection
actions.expected: Duplicate creates two offset graph nodes without opening an editor.

actions.label: Copy the duplicated selection
actions.expected: Copy retains the selected graph subgraph for the ordinary clipboard command.

actions.label: Paste the graph selection
actions.expected: Paste creates fresh graph identities through the canvas command.

actions.label: Delete the pasted selection
actions.expected: Delete removes only the current selection and reports the mutation through the polite canvas status.

actions.label: Undo the keyboard delete
actions.expected: Undo restores the pasted selection.

actions.label: Redo the keyboard delete
actions.expected: Redo reapplies the deletion without losing canvas focus.

actions.label: Restore the edited Prompt selection
actions.expected: The target is reached from the actual current focus using keyboard traversal only.
actions.actual: Reached Keyboard brief with 4 Tab key events.

actions.label: Restore the edited Prompt selection
actions.expected: The renamed Prompt is selected for its keyboard-accessible Inspector help.

actions.label: Reach Setup help
actions.expected: The target is reached from the actual current focus using keyboard traversal only.
actions.actual: Reached Setup help with 29 Tab key events.

actions.label: Dismiss the focused Setup tooltip
actions.expected: Escape closes the focus tooltip without changing graph selection.

actions.label: Open keyboard reference from its focused toolbar control
actions.expected: The target is reached from the actual current focus using keyboard traversal only.
actions.actual: Reached Keyboard and pointer reference with 62 Tab key events.

actions.label: Open keyboard reference from its focused toolbar control
actions.expected: Enter opens the keyboard-help modal and transfers focus inside it.

actions.label: Close keyboard reference
actions.expected: Escape closes the modal and returns focus to its toolbar trigger.

actions.label: Keyboard-only J03 subset
actions.expected: The fresh packaged document was authored, edited, multi-selected, duplicated, copied, pasted, deleted, undone, and redone using keyboard focus and real key events.
actions.actual: Library Tab/Enter, canvas N/Enter, F2/Enter, Ctrl+A multi-selection, graph shortcuts, a focus tooltip, reduced-motion CSS targets, and modal Escape focus return all remained available. Pointer-only marquee and move are outside this keyboard subset.

actions.label: Capture keyboard-only authoring state
actions.expected: The packaged blank-authored canvas visibly retains the renamed node after keyboard-only commands.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.
